---
title: "Age"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

# Load the saved spatial Census tract data and drop the empty water tract
sarasota_age <- read_rds("sarasota_age.rds") |>
  drop_na(estimate)

# Draw a map of Sarasota County tracts colored by median age
sarasota_age |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Median Age") +
  labs(
    title = "Median Age by Census Tract in Sarasota County, FL",
    subtitle = "Coastal and barrier-island tracts tend to have the oldest populations",
    caption = "Source: 2018–2022 5-Year American Community Survey (tidycensus)"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 13)
```
